data.title: Library reminder: overdue books (1st reminder)
data.summary: Stadtbibliothek Musterstadt reminds you that two borrowed items are overdue, with fees of €4.50 so far. Please return them by 2 October 2026.
data.explanation: Two library items are past their loan period. Fees of €4.50 have built up so far. Return the items by 2 October 2026, at the service desk or in the return box, which is open around the clock. You can pay the fees when you return them. After that date, fees rise by €0.50 per item per opening day. Once fees reach €10.00, your account is blocked for further loans. If nobody has reserved the items, you can also extend the loan online.

items.title: Return overdue media
items.quote: Bitte geben Sie die Medien bis zum 02.10.2026 zurück.
items.action: Return both items to the library by the date shown (service desk or return box), or extend the loan online if no one has reserved them.
items.consequence: After this date fees rise by €0.50 per item per opening day, and at €10.00 your account is blocked for further loans.

items.title: Pay overdue fees
items.quote: Die bisher entstandenen Gebühren in Höhe von 4,50 € können Sie bei der Rückgabe an der Servicetheke oder am Kassenautomaten bezahlen.
items.action: Pay the €4.50 fees when returning the items, at the service desk or the payment machine.
